title: Andreas History of Cook County — Seth Paine biography excerpt
citation: A. T. Andreas, History of Cook County, Illinois (1884), pp. 315–320, excerpted by IAPSOP; Seth Paine left Montpelier, Vermont in April 1834 and traveled west to Chicago.
notes: The exact uncommon name plus explicit 1834 Chicago migration is strong independent identity evidence for the 1835 postal entry. Later banking/spiritualist material is not back-projected into 1835.
